author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

This PR introduces a Phase-2 HLT **development menu**, `HLT_75e33_dev`, and adds the testing infrastructure around it. It also reorganises the numbering of the Phase-2 HLT relval workflows (`ph2_hlt` set) so that related workflows are grouped together.

**1. New development menu `HLT_75e33_dev`**
- New `HLTrigger/Configuration/python/HLT_75e33_dev_cff.py`: the `HLT_75e33_timing` menu plus new paths under development, so that they can be tested without changing the default Phase-2 menus.
- First content: the `HLT_DoubleMu4_3_{LowMass,Bs,Jpsi}_FromL1TkMuon` paths (by @rovere). They are ports of the Run-3 `HLT_DoubleMu4_3_{LowMass,Bs,Jpsi}` paths of `HLT_GRun`:
  - L1 gate on `GMTTkMuons` (`pDoubleTkMuon_OS_Er1p5_Dr1p4` OR `pDoubleTkMuon_4_4_OS_Dr1p2`; mapped to the `v0p0_2026` names by `customizeHLTforL1P2GTv0p0_2026`).
  - A shared `HLTDoubleMuonLowMassFromL1TkMuonSequence`: Phase-2 L3 muon reconstruction as in `HLT_Mu37_Mu27_FromL1TkMuon`, plus two L3 muons with pT > 3 GeV matched to the seeds.
  - Per path: `HLTMuonDimuonL3Filter` with the Run-3 selections (mass windows 0.2-8.5 / 4.5-6.0 / 2.9-3.3 GeV), then `HLTDisplacedmumuVtxProducer` + `HLTDisplacedmumuFilter` (vertex probability > 0.005).
  - The paths are also added to the muon `HLTGenValSource` in `Phase2_HLT_validation_cfg.py` and to the NGT scouting trigger-object table and DQM.
- The paths are loaded **only** in `HLT_75e33_dev`. `HLT_75e33` and `HLT_75e33_timing` are unchanged with respect to master.
- New `autoHLT` key `relvalRun4_dev`  `75e33_dev`, and a new relval workflow `HLTDev75e33` (`_HLT75e33Dev`, offset **0.7504**): the timing-menu workflow running `HLT:@relvalRun4_dev`. It is added to the `ph2_hlt` set and to the Run-4 IB list.

**2. Renumbering of the Phase-2 HLT relval workflows**

Over time, the `ph2_hlt` offsets ended up mixing unrelated topics (e.g. TICL and MTD variants between the Alpaka and tracking ones). They are now grouped by topic:

| Group | Offsets |
|---|---|
| menu flavours | 0.75, 0.7501, 0.7502, 0.7503, 0.7504 |
| heterogeneous (Alpaka) | 0.751 |
| tracking variants | 0.753, 0.7531, 0.7532, 0.7533 |
| calorimetry (TICL) / timing (MTD) variants | 0.756, 0.7561, 0.7562 |
| HLT NANO | 0.759, 0.7591, 0.7592 |
| NGT scouting, reco variants | 0.77, 0.771, 0.7711 |
| NGT scouting, NANO | 0.772, 0.7721, 0.7722, 0.7723 |

Renumbered workflows (old  new):

| Workflow | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| `HLTTiming75e33LST` | 0.755 | 0.7531 |
| `HLTTiming75e33MkFitFit` | 0.757 | 0.7532 |
| `HLTTiming75e33CAVectorHits` | 0.7512 | 0.7533 |
| `HLTTiming75e33TiclBarrel` | 0.758 | 0.756 |
| `HLTTiming75e33TiclV5TrackLinkingGNN` | 0.7521 | 0.7561 |
| `HLTTiming75e33MTDatHLT` | 0.7522 | 0.7562 |
| `NGTScoutingCAExtensionMergeT5` | 0.775 | 0.7711 |
| `NGTScoutingWithNanoValid` | 0.773 | 0.7722 |
| `L1NGTScoutingWithNanoValid` | 0.774 | 0.7723 |

Only previously unused offsets are introduced, so no existing workflow number is reassigned to a different workflow. The old numbers simply disappear. The change is propagated to `upgradeWorkflowComponents.py`, `runTheMatrix.py` (`ph2_hlt` set), `relval_Run4.py` (IB list), `relval_nano.py` and the `Configuration/PyReleaseValidation/README.md` offset table.

**Expected changes in the output:** none for the existing menus and workflows, apart from the workflow numbers listed above. Anyone using the old numbers (e.g. in `test workflows` requests or private scripts) needs to switch to the new ones.

No dependencies on other PRs or externals.

#### PR validation:

- Checked that all upgrade workflow offsets are unique after the renumbering, and that each workflow name maps to the intended offset.
- `runTheMatrix.py --what upgrade -l ph2_hlt` and `runTheMatrix.py -s ph2_hlt`.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport, and no backport is foreseen.
title: [Phase-2 HLT]: add `HLT_75e33_dev` menu (with `DoubleMu4_3` low-mass paths) and renumber `ph2_hlt` workflows
